ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious New-PSDrive to Admin Share
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may use to interact with a remote network share using Server Message Block (SMB). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-PSDrive.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-psprovider\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*filesystem.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-root\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\$.*"))
